faq.q: What do I need to send?
faq.a: Your raw footage (a Google Drive, Dropbox or any download link works), references you like and your deadline. Not sure yet? Send what you have and we'll guide you.

faq.q: How long does an edit take?
faq.a: It depends on length and complexity. We confirm a delivery date with every quote and stick to it.
Yes. Revision rounds are included and agreed in your quote.

faq.q: Do you work with international clients?
faq.a: Yes. We work remotely with creators, brands and agencies in Vietnam, the US, the UK and beyond.
Pricing depends on length, style and volume. Send your brief and we'll reply with a free quote.

about.title: About
about.lead: qh.studio is a lean video editing and post-production team based in Vietnam, working with clients worldwide.
story: qh.studio started with one freelance editor who built a YouTube channel from zero to 29.2M views, then edited Reels for creator brands in the US.
Today we're a studio: a small team with a shared workflow, so clients get the speed and flexibility of a freelancer with the reliability of a team.

how.title: Lean team
